research_question: How much mathematical problem-solving ability can be compressed into a very small, memory- and time-efficient, natural-language-only model when formalization, theorem retrieval, and Lean verification are delegated to a fixed external system?

architecture_boundary.small_model_output: natural-language concept list and proof blueprint only

model.full_parameter_guard: The training log must say 100.000% (596.050M/596.050M); stock mlx_lm.lora full mode is not sufficient.

data.cross_split_gate: No family_id or content_id may occur in more than one split; audit statement near-duplicates across splits before freezing.

training.context_choice_rule: Choose the cap with the best validation gain per wall-hour after accounting for the percentage of post-preparation examples that fit without truncation; memory alone does not choose the cap.
training.comparison_budget: equal non-padding training tokens and equal generation/evaluation budgets

checkpoint_policy.keep: baseline, current proxy Pareto leader, previous reproducible leader, and any checkpoint queued for frozen-formalizer evaluation
checkpoint_policy.discard: failed or dominated checkpoints after their config, log, metric record, and checksum metadata are appended to the ledger

adaptive_schedule.short_trial_stop: Stop when the candidate can be ranked against the incumbent with the frozen proxy confidence rule, or when its declared token/wall budget is exhausted.
progression: calibrate context, optimizer, and data-shape costs
compare coherent curriculum or blueprint-schema changes on family-held-out validation
re-run a surprising winner with a second seed
spend the largest remaining block on one substantial run only after a reproducible proxy leader exists
adaptive_schedule.overnight_planning_envelope: Approximately 10-18 development cycles plus zero or one 2-4 hour substantial run, with the final 45 minutes reserved for validation, checkpoint pruning, and ledger audit. This is an estimate, not a quota.

metrics: concept-label precision and recall where labels are audited
proxy_evaluation.claim_boundary: Proxy improvements justify another experiment or retention of a checkpoint; they do not establish mathematical reasoning or verified theorem uplift.

scientific_evaluation.primary_metric: paired faithful Lean-verified solve-rate uplift of model_blueprint over no_blueprint, in percentage points
scientific_evaluation.confidence_interval: 95% family-cluster bootstrap with 10000 resamples and seed 20260719
baselines: same frozen formalizer with no blueprint
retrieval-only blueprint under the same retrieval snapshot
scientific_evaluation.interactive_agent_warning: The current GPT-5.6 Sol interactive agent is not a reproducibly frozen external formalizer. It may prepare data and inspect failures, but scientific results require the binding above.

promotion_rule.proxy: Keep a candidate only on the Pareto frontier of validation completion loss, parse rate, wall time, peak memory, and checkpoint size. Re-run surprising wins; never promote from training loss.
promotion_rule.scientific: Promote only if model_blueprint has positive paired uplift over no_blueprint, beats corrupted_blueprint and generic_blueprint, the 95% family-cluster interval excludes zero, and there is no statement-faithfulness regression.

benchmark_command: uv run python scripts/score_formalizer_results.py --config configs/experiment.v1.json --outcomes runs/frozen-formalizer/outcomes.jsonl
